eli: Quick heads-up: saw a perf regression on 1F1B baseline after commit abcdef1. PP bubble is larger on several runs, e2e latency +18%. Putting traces here.
perf-bot: New profile uploaded: https://internal.perf/trace/2539990000 - summary: all-reduce avg increased, comm/compute overlap dropped.
alice: Can you paste the flamegraph + microbatch/TP/PP config?
eli: Microbatch=4, TP=2, PP=4, seq=2048. Observed numbers: all-reduce avg went from ~430us -> ~640us, overlap metric from 72% -> 47%.
eli: Profiler snippet:
```
[pp-step] step=1024 microbatch=4 allreduce_ms=0.64 compute_ms=1.35 overlap=47% kv_prefetch_ms=0.12
[kernel-select] attention_kernel=fp4_int8_gemm (selected at compile)
```
frank: Kernel selector picked fp4_int8_gemm after the kernel patch; we saw higher reduction throughput but more fragmentation on small slices -> increased latency on all-reduce.
dana: Also check KV cache shard behavior. KV memcpy rate spiked in the trace (noticed extra memcpy for kvcache_shard=64). Did we flip kvcache_spill=true in the config? That would hurt overlap.
bkumar: I ran a quick local run with --microbatch=2: bubble shrinks from ~220ms -> ~150ms but p99 e2e moved slightly up. Sweeping microbatch sizes will show tradeoffs.
eli: Immediate repro command I used:
```
./run_inference.sh --model=redwood-xl --tp=2 --pp=4 --microbatch=4 --seq=2048 --profile=pp_trace.json
```
eli: Also tried toggling use_contiguous_allreduce=false -> reduced avg all-reduce to ~470us (better overlap), so kernel layout/pack matters.
alice: Can we force the previous kernel to validate? try REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=legacy_gemm and recompile quick.
frank: +1. Also try increasing pipeline prefetch from 1->2: `pipeline.prefetch=2` tends to raise overlap in 1F1B at cost of memory. Watch kv_cache memory pressure.
perf-bot: Enqueued experiments: id=2539990055 sweep microbatch=[1,4] kernel=[legacy,int8] prefetch=[1,3]
eli: I'll run those and post a short table later. For mitigation we can pin heavy customer routes to legacy kernel until we confirm.
alice: Thanks. If experiments show it's kernel related we'll rollback the kernel selector change. :eyes:
bkumar: I'll also check all-reduce implementation commit range and profile NVLink contention during the sweep.
eli: Cool — will update by EOD. If anyone wants to jump on pairing to triage now ping me. :ear:
